phase_name: Deploy and Verify the Fix Is Live

objectives.description: Deploy source store, work around the known copy_scripts gap for the new test file, verify deployed suite passes, and confirm live end-to-end via this task's own commit
objectives.note: deploy-headless.sh deployed 303 artifacts and updated the existing git-commit-scoped.sh, but did NOT copy the brand-new tests/test-git-commit-scoped.sh (the documented already-loaded-extension copy_scripts gap). Worked around via a direct one-off nvim --headless luafile invocation of loader_mod.copy_scripts + loader_mod.copy_manifest against the core extension's source_dir/target_dir -- no .claude/** file hand-authored. Deployed suite: 7 passed, 0 failed. Live confirmation: an identical git-commit-scoped.sh invocation against the PRE-fix deployed script had already failed with rc=2 (paths are ignored: specs/967_.../.lock) earlier in this session; after deploy, the same commit (accumulating phases 1-4 plus this phase) landed as commit 2e70e0114 with .lock/holder.json present and held throughout, and zero ephemeral paths in the commit's file list.
